The user can never save any organization setting until they switch to one of the 14 whitelisted currencies — and the UI still presents all ~150 as valid options.
broken.moneyImpact: No direct mis-accounting, but a legitimately-configured tenant (running in a non-EUR/USD/GBP/... currency) is permanently locked out of editing organization settings — name, locale, company info, billing — because the form always re-sends the stored currency. Hard operational block for any of ~150 valid currencies.

verdict.reasoning: The claim is real in current code. The asymmetry is concrete and exact: add() (POST /realms, the firstaccess path) validates name + locale but never validates the currency value (only its presence in _hasRequiredFields:51), while update() (PATCH /realms/:id) validates currency against a 14-code whitelist (227-229). The firstaccess dropdown offers 167 ISO currencies (153 outside the whitelist), all of which render money correctly via Intl.NumberFormat and all of which the realm schema accepts at creation (no enum on currency). Once a realm is created with e.g. MXN/PLN/ZAR/TRY/AED, the org-settings form re-submits currency on EVERY save (mergeOrganization spreads orgPart which always carries currency: landlord.currency, seeded from the stored value), so update() throws Invalid currency 422 on any subsequent edit of name/locale/companyInfo. The user is permanently locked out of editing organization settings until they switch to one of the 14 whitelisted codes — while the UI continues to present all 167 as valid. No guard fixes this: there is no zod refinement on currency in baseSchema (LandlordForm.js:30-44, currency is just z.string().min(1)), no enum in the realm Mongoose schema, and no middleware currency check. Impact is operational lockout, not direct mis-accounting, but it is a hard block for any of ~150 legitimately-configured currencies. Minimal leak location: realmmanager.ts add() omits the validateEnum(currency, CURRENCIES) call that update() has — the inverse problem (dropdown too wide vs whitelist too narrow) could also be fixed by widening CURRENCIES at validators.ts:51-66 to match the dropdown's symbol-backed set. Either fix closes the lockout. Severity high per the reviewer's framing.

broken.title: Personal-account landlord can save bankName with empty IBAN → every rent-call PDF prints a dangling empty 'IBAN' line; no IBAN format validation anywhere
broken.line:
BillingForm.js:52-53 (bankName/iban z.string().optional() when !isCompany), :108 (onSubmit always sends bankInfo:{name,iban}); data/index.js:80 (landlord.hasBankInfo = !!landlord.bankInfo); paymentmodalities.ejs:5-9 (gates on hasBankInfo, renders '
IBAN <%= landlord.bankInfo.iban %>')
broken.brokenShape: For a personal account (isCompany=false) BillingForm makes both bankName and iban z.string().optional(), and onSubmit ALWAYS emits bankInfo:{ name: billing.bankName, iban: billing.iban } (line 108) regardless of whether they are filled. bankInfo is a Mongoose nested path so realm.bankInfo is a truthy object whenever EITHER subfield is set; hasBankInfo = !!landlord.bankInfo is therefore true when only name is set. paymentmodalities.ejs line 9 then renders the literal label _.t('IBAN') followed by an empty value. Separately, isValidIBAN (validators.ts) is never called on the realm save path (grep of realmmanager.ts + routes.ts: zero callers), and BillingForm has no IBAN-format check — any typed string persists verbatim.
broken.trigger: Personal-account landlord enters Bank name (e.g. 'Εθνική Τράπεζα') in Settings → Billing, leaves IBAN blank (allowed), Saves. Generate a rent-call / reminder PDF for any tenant → the PAYMENT METHODS block shows a bank-transfer section with an empty 'IBAN' line. A typo'd IBAN ('GR16 0110 ...x') likewise prints unchallenged on every bill.
broken.moneyImpact: Bills/rent-calls instruct the tenant to pay by bank transfer to an empty or malformed IBAN → misdirected or failed payments. The empty 'IBAN ' line is also a blank-render defect on a customer-facing money document.

verdict.codeEvidence:
BillingForm.js:51-53 schema for personal account: `bankName: isCompany ? z.string().min(1) : z.string().optional(), iban: isCompany ? z.string().min(1) : z.string().optional()`. BillingForm.js:108 onSubmit ALWAYS emits `bankInfo: { name: billing.bankName, iban: billing.iban }` (blank IBAN input → billing.iban === '' because defaultValues line 74 is `iban: organization.bankInfo?.iban || ''`). utils.js:47-58 mergeOrganization spreads `...orgPart` and never strips empty bankInfo. realmmanager.ts update() validates locale/currency/members/capital/emails/thirdParties but NOT bankInfo; line 344 `const updatedRealm = { ...previousObj, ...req.body, ... }` carries bankInfo verbatim into line 457 `previousRealm.set(updatedRealm)`; no isValidIBAN call on this path (grep: the only isValidIBAN caller is buildingmanager.ts:676 for building.manager.iban — a different document). realm.ts:51-54 `bankInfo: { name: String, iban: String }` is a Mongoose NESTED PATH. Empirically confirmed under the installed mongoose 6.13.6 (services/common/package.json:34): a hydrated doc `new Realm({ bankInfo: { name: 'X', iban: '' } })` gives `!!doc.bankInfo === true` and `doc.bankInfo.iban === ''`; a doc that never set bankInfo gives hydrated `bankInfo === {}` → still truthy. data/index.js:80 `landlord.hasBankInfo = !!landlord.bankInfo` where landlord = dbTenant.realmId from `.populate('realmId')` (lines 31-34, 66) — a HYDRATED doc (not .lean()), so bankInfo is truthy. paymentmodalities.ejs:5-9 gates only on `hasBankInfo` then unconditionally renders line 9 `
<%= _.t('IBAN') %> <%= landlord.bankInfo.iban %>` (IBAN label resolves to literal 'IBAN' in templates/locales/{el,en}.json:19). Partial included by rentcall.ejs / rentcall_reminder.ejs / rentcall_last_reminder.ejs each at line 36.
verdict.reasoning: Every link in the reviewer's chain holds against current code at HEAD f6f75966, and I verified the one load-bearing assumption (nested-path truthiness) empirically rather than from memory. A personal-account landlord can save bankName with iban='' (both optional, BillingForm.js:52-53); onSubmit always sends bankInfo:{name,iban} (line 108); nothing on the merge (utils.js) or server (realmmanager.ts update) path strips the empty subfield or validates the IBAN — isValidIBAN is never called on the realm path (its only caller is buildingmanager.ts:676 for building.manager, a distinct document). Because bankInfo is a Mongoose nested path and the pdfgenerator reads it off the HYDRATED populate('realmId') doc, hasBankInfo=!!landlord.bankInfo is true whenever name is set (or even when bankInfo was never configured at all), and paymentmodalities.ejs renders a dangling 'IBAN ' line with an empty value on every rent-call / reminder PDF. The IBAN-format-validation gap is also real: no client or server format check, so a typo'd IBAN persists and prints verbatim. The empirical test even surfaced a slightly broader variant (never-configured realm → hydrated bankInfo={} → hasBankInfo=true → empty name AND empty IBAN lines), reinforcing the defect. Severity medium is appropriate: customer-facing money document instructing payment to an empty/malformed IBAN.
verdict.correctedDetail: Minimal leak location: services/pdfgenerator/templates/partials/paymentmodalities.ejs:5 — the gate `if (landlord.hasBankInfo)` is too weak; the bank-transfer block (and specifically the IBAN line at :9) should be gated on a non-empty IBAN, e.g. `if (landlord.bankInfo && landlord.bankInfo.iban && landlord.bankInfo.name)`, and line 9 should additionally suppress the empty value. Root cause two-fold: (a) data/index.js:80 computes hasBankInfo = !!landlord.bankInfo which is truthy for an empty/partial nested path on a hydrated doc — it should be `!!(landlord.bankInfo && landlord.bankInfo.iban)`; (b) realmmanager.ts update() never calls isValidIBAN on req.body.bankInfo.iban (the helper exists at validators.ts:579 and is wired into buildingmanager.ts:676 only). One correction to the reviewer's wording: the empty-IBAN-line outcome does not strictly require bankName to be set — because the pdfgenerator reads the hydrated populate('realmId') doc (not toObject/lean), a realm that never configured bankInfo at all also yields hasBankInfo=true and renders both an empty bank-name line and an empty IBAN line; the reviewer's name-set scenario is the most likely real-world trigger but the underlying gate is even leakier than claimed.

broken.title: Accounting JSON endpoint (GET /accounting/:year) constructs Intl.NumberFormat unconditionally in _settlements → 500 RangeError when realm.currency is empty/undefined, even though rawData never formats
broken.line: 282 (const NumberFormat = Intl.NumberFormat(locale,{style:'currency',currency,...}) — unconditional), vs 169-175 and 217-223 where _incomingTenants/_outgoingTenants gate the same construction on !rawData; called from all() at :410 with rawData defaulting true
broken.brokenShape: _settlements builds the currency formatter at line 282 with no rawData guard, unlike _incomingTenants (169) and _outgoingTenants (217) which only construct it when !rawData. The JSON endpoint all() (line 398-412) calls _settlements(tenants, realm.locale, realm.currency) with rawData=true (default), so the formatter is constructed even though the rawData branch (lines 315-327) never calls .format(). Intl.NumberFormat({style:'currency', currency:''}) throws RangeError at construction; currency:undefined throws TypeError — both verified empirically.
broken.trigger: Any realm whose currency is empty-string or undefined (reachable via direct mongo seed of a legacy/partially-corrupt realm — the project's documented real-data seeding path — or a malformed currency string slipping through add() which does not validate currency). Hit GET /api/v2/accounting/<year> (the Accounting page JSON load). _settlements line 282 throws RangeError/TypeError → asyncWrapper surfaces HTTP 500. The entire Accounting page fails to load even though incoming/outgoing tenant data would have rendered fine (their formatters are correctly gated).
broken.moneyImpact: Accounting / settlements year view is entirely unavailable (500) for an affected realm; the landlord cannot see any of the year's payment ledger. The defensive gating that protects the other two sections was not mirrored onto _settlements.

verdict.codeEvidence:
accountingmanager.ts:282-286 (_settlements, UNCONDITIONAL — no rawData guard):
  const NumberFormat = Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: 2
  });
vs the gated siblings _incomingTenants (169-175) and _outgoingTenants (217-223):
  const NumberFormat = !rawData
    ? Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency, minimumFractionDigits: 2 })
    : { format: (value: number) => value };

all() JSON endpoint (line 398-411):
  res.json({ year,
    incomingTenants: _incomingTenants(tenants),      // no currency arg; rawData=true → identity formatter, no Intl call
    outgoingTenants: _outgoingTenants(tenants),       // same
    settlements: _settlements(tenants, realm.locale, realm.currency)  // 3 args → rawData defaults true (sig line 280 `rawData = true`)
  });
_settlements rawData=true branch (316-356, 375-383) stores raw payment objects and NEVER calls NumberFormat.format() — yet line 282 builds the formatter unconditionally before reaching that branch.

Runtime confirmation (node, system Intl):
  Intl.NumberFormat('el',{style:'currency',currency:'',  ...})  → RangeError: Invalid currency code :
  Intl.NumberFormat('el',{style:'currency',currency:undefined})→ TypeError: Currency code is required with currency style.
  Intl.NumberFormat('el',{style:'currency',currency:'XYZW'})    → RangeError: Invalid currency code : XYZW

Reachability:
- realm.ts:114 `currency: String` — NO default, NO required; schema accepts '' / missing. Direct mongo seed of a legacy/partially-corrupt realm (the project's documented real-data seeding path) lands currency:'' or undefined.
- realmmanager.ts add() (143-177): validates name + locale enums but DOES NOT run validateEnum(currency, CURRENCIES). _hasRequiredFields line 51 `provided: !!realm.currency` only rejects falsy; a non-empty malformed code like 'XYZW' passes add() and persists, then crashes line 282.
- realmmanager.ts update() (227-229): `if (req.body.currency !== undefined) validateEnum(...)`; validateEnum (validators.ts:149) returns undefined for ''; but updatedRealm merge (342-348) sets currency:'' which then trips _hasRequiredFields(350) → 422, so update() IS guarded against empty. (Reviewer's "slipping through add()" wording is imprecise for empty/undefined but correct for malformed non-empty codes.)
verdict.reasoning: The structural asymmetry is real and matches disk exactly: _settlements (line 282) builds the currency Intl.NumberFormat unconditionally, while _incomingTenants (169) and _outgoingTenants (217) only build it when !rawData and otherwise use an identity formatter. all() (line 410) calls _settlements with rawData defaulting true, so the formatter is constructed even though the rawData branch never formats. I empirically confirmed that currency:'' throws RangeError and currency:undefined throws TypeError at the Intl.NumberFormat constructor — before the rawData branch is ever reached, and before line 288's moment.localeData call. A realm with empty/undefined currency is structurally valid (realm.ts:114 has no default/required) and reachable via the project's documented direct-mongo-seed path for legacy/corrupt realms; additionally a malformed non-empty currency code (e.g. 'XYZW') slips through add() (which does not validateEnum currency) and crashes line 282 the same way. Result: GET /api/v2/accounting/:year returns HTTP 500 for an affected realm, taking down the entire Accounting page even though incoming/outgoing tenant data would have rendered fine (their formatters are correctly gated). The defensive `!rawData` gate present on the other two sections was simply not mirrored onto _settlements. Minimal fix: gate line 282 identically — `const NumberFormat = !rawData ? Intl.NumberFormat(locale,{style:'currency',currency,minimumFractionDigits:2}) : { format: (value: number) => value };`. The reviewer's only imprecision is claiming empty/undefined currency slips through add() (it is caught by _hasRequiredFields); the bug nonetheless holds via the seed path and via malformed non-empty codes, and the unguarded crash site is exactly line 282 as claimed. Severity medium is fair.
verdict.correctedDetail: Reviewer's reachability claim needs one correction: empty-string / undefined currency does NOT slip through add() — _hasRequiredFields (realmmanager.ts:51, `!!realm.currency`) rejects falsy currency with 422 on both add() and update() (the latter via the merge at lines 342-350). The genuine reach for the reviewer's exact empty/undefined trigger is the documented direct-mongo-seed path (schema realm.ts:114 has no default/required). Separately, add() DOES leak a malformed but non-empty currency (e.g. 'XYZW') because add() never calls validateEnum(currency, CURRENCIES) — only update() does (line 228) — and that also throws RangeError at line 282. Either route produces the same HTTP 500. The crash location and the missing-guard diagnosis are exactly as the reviewer states.

broken.title: Accounting CSV exports are NOT formula-injection-sanitized — the _sanitizeCsvText guard was applied to the in-app JSON branch instead of the actual downloaded CSV
broken.line: 31 (guard defined); 352-354 (only call sites — JSON rawData branch); 199-207 + 260-272 (CSV name/reference/properties emitted unsanitized); 434/464/486 (Parser built with no formula escape). Routes: services/api/src/routes.ts:465-474
broken.brokenShape: _sanitizeCsvText(s) prefixes a leading single-quote when a free-text value starts with = + - @ \t \r (the documented Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets formula-injection guard, comment l20-29). It is invoked ONLY at l352-354 on description/notepromo/noteextracharge inside the `rawData=true` branch of _settlements — i.e. the JSON returned by GET /accounting/:year, which the in-app React UI renders (NOT a spreadsheet). The three CSV DOWNLOAD endpoints — incomingTenantsAsCsv, outgoingTenantsAsCsv, settlementsAsCsv (routes /csv/tenants/incoming|outgoing/:year, /csv/settlements/:year) — call _incomingTenants/_outgoingTenants/_settlements with rawData=false and emit tenant `name` (l200/261), `reference` (l201/262) and `properties` (joined property names via _properties(tenant,false), l160) DIRECTLY into `new Parser({fields, delimiter:';', withBOM:true})` (l434/464/486). json2csv handles quote/newline escaping but NOT the formula-prefix vector (acknowledged in the comment at l28-29 and l346-350). So those columns reach the .csv unguarded, with the user-controlled value as the LEADING cell character.
broken.trigger: Create a tenant with name `=cmd|'/C calc'!A0` (or `@SUM(1+1)`, or `-2+3`, or a property named `=HYPERLINK("http://evil","pay here")`). Server validation accepts it: tenant name only runs validateStringField {min:1,max:200} (occupantmanager.ts:930-934 — no character allowlist); property name only requires a non-empty trimmed string (propertymanager.ts:95-99). The landlord/accountant then downloads GET /api/v2/csv/tenants/incoming/2026 (or outgoing/settlements). The malicious name lands as the first character of the Name/Properties CSV cell; opening the file in Excel/LibreOffice/Google Sheets evaluates it as a formula — the exact RCE/exfiltration vector _sanitizeCsvText exists to neutralise, but it never runs on this path.
broken.moneyImpact: Formula injection in the accounting CSV the landlord hands to their accountant: =HYPERLINK / =WEBSERVICE / DDE payloads can exfiltrate the spreadsheet's other cells (real rent/deposit figures) or run commands on the accountant's machine. No money is mis-summed by the app, but the financial export is a malware/exfiltration carrier — and the guard meant to stop exactly this is silently inert on the download path.

verdict.codeEvidence:
accountingmanager.ts:31 `function _sanitizeCsvText(s: string): string {` — the documented Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets formula-injection guard (comment l20-29: "neutralise CSV formula injection in any free-text field that ends up in the export").

The three CSV DOWNLOAD endpoints emit user-controlled free-text UNGUARDED in the rawData==false path:
- _incomingTenants l202 `name: tenant.name`, l203 `reference: tenant.reference`, `properties: _properties(tenant, rawData)` (l160 `tenant.properties.map(({ name }) => name).join('\n')`)

So a tenant name `=cmd|'/C calc'!A0`, `@SUM(1+1)`, `-2+3`, or a property `=HYPERLINK("http://evil","x")` is stored intact and lands as the LEADING char of the Name/Reference/Properties CSV cell. verdict.reasoning: I independently opened accountingmanager.ts in full, routes.ts:455-475, occupantmanager.ts:920-934, and validators.ts:226-258, and grepped for every _sanitizeCsvText reference across services/ and webapps/. Every claim in the report matches disk: (1) the guard is defined at l31; (2) its ONLY call sites are l352-354 inside the `if (rawData)` (JSON) branch at l316 — confirmed by grep returning no other functional occurrence, and the compiled dist (l305-307) mirrors source, so the LIVE DEPLOYED build ships the same inert guard; (3) the three CSV download handlers all call their builders with rawData=false (l423/450/479) and emit tenant name (l202/263), reference (l203/264) and joined property names (via _properties l160) directly into a json2csv Parser (l434/464/486) constructed with no formula-escape; (4) the validator that gates tenant names (validateStringField) imposes no character allowlist, so the four classic CSV-injection payloads (= + - @) survive creation as the leading cell character. Minimal leak location: the three rawData==false builders must run _sanitizeCsvText over name/reference/properties (and the per-month settlement cell strings) before handing to the Parser at l434/464/486; equivalently, lift the sanitize call out of the `if (rawData)` block so it covers the export path it was written for.

broken.title: DEH bill amount parser treats a bare thousands-separator dot (no comma) as a decimal point — a €1.234 round-euro bill parses as €1.23
broken.line: 3-11 (parseGreekAmount), used at 41 and 48
broken.brokenShape: parseGreekAmount() only applies the Greek dot-thousands/comma-decimal normalization (`cleaned.replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.')`) inside `if (cleaned.includes(','))`. When the extracted amount string contains a dot but NO comma, the branch is skipped and parseFloat() runs on the raw string, so a Greek thousands dot is misread as a JS decimal point: parseFloat('1.234') === 1.234, not 1234. The total amount captured by Pattern 1 (l37-39) / Pattern 2 (l46) regexes both feed this function.
broken.trigger: Import/parse a DEH bill whose ΣΥΝΟΛΙΚΟ ΠΟΣΟ ΠΛΗΡΩΜΗΣ is a round-thousands amount printed without explicit cents and with a thousands dot, e.g. '1.234 €' or '*1.500€' (>= €1000, no ,NN suffix). parseGreekAmount returns 1.234 / 1.5 instead of 1234 / 1500.
broken.moneyImpact: A bill's totalAmount is recorded ~1000x too small (€1234 → €1.23), understating the expense/charge that flows into building-expense allocation and the IRIS QR/RF payment surfaces. Low likelihood because Greek DEH invoices conventionally always print cents (',NN'), in which case the comma branch fires and the value is correct; the bug only bites round-euro amounts >= €1000 rendered without a decimal comma.

verdict.reasoning: The reviewer's claim is accurate against current code. parseGreekAmount applies the dot-thousands/comma-decimal normalization (L6-8) only inside `if (cleaned.includes(','))` (L5). The comma is therefore doing double duty: it is both the decimal marker AND the sole trigger for stripping thousands-dots. A round-euro amount printed with a thousands dot and no decimal comma (e.g. '1.234') falls through to a bare parseFloat (L9), which reads the dot as a JS decimal point and returns 1.234 instead of 1234 — a ~1000x understatement. Both feeding regexes (L37-39, L46) accept comma-less dotted strings, the dispatcher reaches parseDehBill with raw extracted text (no normalization), and the only downstream sanity guard (billmanager.ts L232, _ta <= 0.005) does not reject a small-but-positive misparse. I traced the exact path from regex capture → parseGreekAmount → wrong number → persisted totalAmount in code I read; the line numbers match disk. This is not already-guarded, not a misread, and not historical-fixed. Severity is genuinely low (and the reviewer says so): real Greek DEH invoices conventionally print cents with a decimal comma, in which case the comma branch fires and the value is correct; the defect only bites a round-thousands amount >= €1000 rendered without ',NN', and the parse step shows the (wrong) value to the user for confirmation before saving. But the defect itself — an asymmetric normalizer that mis-reads a Greek thousands separator when no decimal comma is present — is real and unguarded in the current function. Minimal-leak location: deh.ts L5 — the normalization must also handle the dot-only case (e.g. treat a lone dot before exactly 3 trailing digits as a thousands separator, or strip grouping dots whenever no comma is present), rather than gating all dot-handling on the presence of a comma.

punchList:
# PUNCH-LIST — MicroRealEstate Round-2 Audit (HEAD f6f75966, branch nas)

Deduped to **24 distinct root causes**. The PDF-VAT, multi-property-address, accounting-Owners-tab, incoming-tenants-date, settlements-CSV-date, typeless-payment-crash, month-locale, CSV-injection, surplus-badge, payment-toast, owner-toast, and emailer-Total findings each appeared 2-4x in the source set — collapsed to one entry apiece.

---

## CRITICAL — wrong/dropped/double-counted money on a write path

### C1. Express settle records GROSS bill on a partially-paid term AND destroys the prior payment
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/rentmanager.ts:103-189` (`_computeOwedLines` never subtracts `targetRent.payments`/`total.payment`) + `:548-611` (records gross) + `:1052` (`settlements.payments = paymentData.payments` — no merge of existing payments); client shows NET at `webapps/landlord/src/components/rents/ExpressPaymentDialog.js:55-71`.
- **Trigger:** Term with €500 bill + €200 recorded payment → drawer shows "Monthly €300" → Record → server writes one €500 transfer dated today; the €200 payment (date/type/reference) is permanently overwritten.
- **Impact:** Over-records by the already-paid amount AND deletes a real payment record; toast reports only a count, so it's silent. Double-hit to ledger + audit trail.
- **Fix direction:** In `bulkExpressPayment`, net `targetRent.total.payment` out of `monthlyOwed` AND include existing `targetRent.payments` in `paymentData.payments` — mirror `PaymentTabs.js:596` (`[...savedPayments, ...drafts]`).

### C2. Express settle ignores the standing lease discount — over-charges every discounted tenant
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/rentmanager.ts:103-189` (`_computeOwedLines` sums preTax+charges+buildingCharges+vat+debts, never subtracts `rent.discounts`) vs `7_total.ts:64-67` (`grandTotal` does subtract discount).
- **Trigger:** Tenant with `occupant.discount=50` on €500 rent, fully unpaid → drawer shows "Monthly €450" → Record → server records €500 transfer → +€50 phantom credit cascades to next term.
- **Impact:** Over-records by the full standing discount on every Express settle of a discounted tenant (independent of payments — fires on a clean term).
- **Fix direction:** Make `_computeOwedLines` net `rent.discounts` into the rent/preTax owed lines, matching `7_total.ts`'s `- discount`.

---

## HIGH — wrong money / reject-valid-data / lockout / surface-down

### H1. Property expense-sum collapses an entire property's Additional charges to €0 when any one expense lacks a numeric amount
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/frontdata.ts:495-501` — `item.expenses.reduce((acc,{amount})=>acc+amount,0)` has no `Number()||0`; an `undefined` amount → NaN → `(length && NaN)||0` → **0**. Engine (`1_base.ts:906-908`) correctly coerces.
- **Trigger:** PATCH a tenant with a property holding `[{amount:100},{title:'Legacy'/*no amount*/},{amount:30}]` (validator accepts it; `occupantmanager.ts:670` only checks amount when present), or any legacy row. Overview shows Additional charges €0 / Total = rent-only; ledger bills €130.
- **Impact:** Tenant Rental overview silently under-states the whole property's expense sum (and Pre-tax/VAT/Total); diverges from the ledger in the same payload.
- **Fix direction:** Coerce in the reduce: `(acc,{amount})=>acc+(Number(amount)||0)` — match the engine at `1_base.ts:906`. (Fires only on `undefined`/missing, not literal `null`.)

### H2. Receipt PDF "Σύνολο πληρωμής" (Total with VAT) understated by full VAT for any VAT-liable tenant
- **Root cause:** `services/pdfgenerator/data/index.js:122-133` — receipt (`omitCharges`) branch `invoiceGrandTotal = round(subTotal + balance)` with **no VAT addend**, while the rent-call branch (`:134`) uses canonical `grandTotal` (which includes VAT). `...rent.total` spread still prints the VAT line at `invoicetotal.ejs:6-11`.
- **Trigger:** Any tenant with `vatRatio>0`; rent 1000 / 24% → receipt prints Σύνολο πριν ΦΠΑ 1000, ΦΠΑ 240, **Σύνολο πληρωμής 1000** (should be 1240). `newBalance=1000−payment` → a full-1240 payer shows €240 phantom credit; a 1000 payer shows €0 due while owing VAT.
- **Impact:** Greek tax receipt does not foot; understates collected gross/VAT; phantom credit/debt on the balance line.
- **Fix direction:** `data/index.js:133` — add `(rent.total.vat||0)` to the receipt branch (or reuse canonical `grandTotal`), so the headline matches the printed VAT line and `newBalance` follows.

### H3. Reminder/last-reminder dunning emails bill GROSS `grandTotal`, not remaining-after-partial-payment
- **Root cause:** `rentcall_reminder/body_html.ejs:22` + `body_text.ejs:9`; `rentcall_last_reminder/body_html.ejs:30` + `body_text.ejs:15` — all quote `tenant.rents[0].total.grandTotal`, which never subtracts `rent.total.payment` (`7_total.ts:69`). **All four** template files affected.
- **Trigger:** Tenant pays €600 of a €1000 term → landlord sends reminder/last-reminder → email demands the full €1000 ("current amount of unpaid rents is 1.000,00 €") instead of €400.
- **Impact:** Over-dunns every partially-paid tenant by the amount already paid, on a legally-sensitive pre-eviction notice; contradicts the landlord's own "Owed remaining" UI.
- **Fix direction:** Quote `Math.max(0, grandTotal − total.payment)` in all four reminder templates. Leave the initial `rentcall` body (gross) alone.

### H4. Empty post-filter `rents[]` 422s every rentcall/reminder email for an out-of-window term
- **Root cause:** `services/emailer/src/emailparts/data/invoice/index.ts:22` guards `!dbTenant.rents.length` (FULL ledger, pre-filter), then `:52-54` filters to `params.term`; templates deref `rents[0].total.grandTotal`. Reminder builders reuse `Invoice.get`.
- **Trigger:** `POST /emailer` rentcall/reminder for a term outside the materialized rent window (terminated tenant later month, future-month before lease begins, automated caller). → TypeError → caught → `ServiceError('missing content', 422)`; no email sent.
- **Impact:** Landlord believes a notice/dunning was sent; it silently 422s. For last-reminder, can break the eviction timeline. (`lease_expiry_notice` already wraps `Invoice.get` in try/catch — proof the failure mode is known.)
- **Fix direction:** Move the empty-check to AFTER the term filter (re-check `tenant.rents.length` post-filter and throw a clear handled error / skip gracefully).

### H5. Empty/invalid `realm.currency` → 500 RangeError on the entire Accounting page + all CSV exports
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/accountingmanager.ts:282` — `_settlements` builds `Intl.NumberFormat(locale,{style:'currency',currency,...})` **unconditionally**, unlike `_incomingTenants:169-175` / `_outgoingTenants:217-223` which gate construction on `!rawData`. Reached by JSON `all()` at `:410` (rawData=true) and by `settlementsAsCsv:479`. Emitter side: emailer `templatefunctions.ts` / `routes.ts:41` (`currency || ''`) throws the same way for emails.
- **Trigger:** Realm with `currency:''`/`undefined` (direct-mongo/legacy seed; schema `realm.ts:114` has no default/required) or a malformed non-empty code slipping through `add()` (which doesn't validate currency). GET `/accounting/:year` → RangeError → 500. Money-bearing emails 422 likewise.
- **Impact:** Year-end reconciliation surface (settlements grid + all 3 CSVs) entirely unavailable; rentcall/reminder emails 422 for the realm (receipt still sends, masking it).
- **Fix direction:** Gate `accountingmanager.ts:282` like its siblings (`!rawData ? Intl.NumberFormat(...) : {format:v=>v}`); add `validateEnum(req.body.currency, CURRENCIES)` to `realmmanager.add()`; default/normalize `realm.currency` (e.g. `realm.ts:114` default 'EUR' or guard at `routes.ts:41`).

### H6. Org-settings PATCH permanently 422-locks any realm using one of ~150 valid ISO currencies the dropdown offers but the server whitelists out
- **Root cause:** Dropdown offers 167 ISO codes (`LandlordForm.js:63-79`), server whitelist `CURRENCIES` is 14 (`validators.ts:51-66`); `update()` runs `validateEnum(currency,CURRENCIES)` (`realmmanager.ts:227-229`) but `add()` does **not** (`:160-172`); `onSubmit` re-sends the stored currency on every PATCH (`LandlordForm.js:189`).
- **Trigger:** Create org with MXN/PLN/ZAR/TRY/AED (offered, valid ISO, renders fine). Then edit any setting (name/locale/company info) → Save → PATCH re-sends `currency:'MXN'` → 422 "Invalid currency". Org settings uneditable forever.
- **Impact:** Hard operational lockout for any of ~150 legitimate currencies; can never save name/locale/company/bank info again.
- **Fix direction:** Make the outlier match: align the dropdown to `CURRENCIES` (or widen `CURRENCIES` to the symbol-backed ISO set Intl accepts), and add the missing `validateEnum(currency,…)` to `add()`.

### H7. Legacy/typeless payment (`type:''` or omitted, `amount>0`) crashes the entire Accounting/Payments page on render
- **Root cause:** Render: `webapps/landlord/src/components/accounting/TenantSettlements.js:167` — `t(type[0].toUpperCase()+type.slice(1))` throws when `type===''`/undefined. Persist: `rentmanager.ts:820` guard nested inside `if (p?.type !== undefined && p.type !== null)` (omitted/null type skips the required check) → `:1108` stores `type: payment.type||''`. Read passes type through raw (`accountingmanager.ts:317-323`).
- **Trigger:** Any legacy/pre-Wave-26 payment with `amount>0` and `type===''`, or a crafted PATCH omitting `type`. Open Accounting → Payments for that year → ErrorBoundary blanks the whole page (not just one row).
- **Impact:** Entire year's Payments accounting view unusable for ALL tenants when one has a typeless positive payment; validation gap also lets such a payment persist.
- **Fix direction:** Guard the render: `type ? t(type[0].toUpperCase()+type.slice(1)) : ''` at `TenantSettlements.js:167`; also fire the required-type throw at `rentmanager.ts:820` when type is undefined/null with `amount>0`.

### H8. Accounting CSV exports ship formula-injection unsanitized — `_sanitizeCsvText` is wired only to the React-JSON path
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/accountingmanager.ts:31` guard; **only** call sites `:352-354` are inside the `if (rawData)` JSON branch (consumed by React, harmless). CSV handlers call builders with `rawData=false` and emit `tenant.name` (`:201/262`), `reference` (`:202/263`), property names (`_properties` `:160`), settlement cell (`:388-392`), payment reference (`:367-369`) raw into `json2csv`. Names/refs only length-validated (`validators.ts:226`), no formula-prefix strip.
- **Trigger:** Tenant named `=cmd|'/C calc'!A1` / `=HYPERLINK("http://evil","x")` (accepted by validators) → landlord exports incoming/outgoing/settlements CSV → opens in Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets → cell evaluates as formula/DDE.
- **Impact:** Arbitrary-formula execution / data exfiltration on the accountant's machine — the exact vector the guard was written to close, left open on the only path that reaches a spreadsheet.
- **Fix direction:** Run `_sanitizeCsvText` over name/reference/property-name/payment-reference whenever `rawData===false` (the three builders' false branches at `:160`, `:201-203`, `:262-264`, `:367-369`, `:388-392`), or move the call out of the `if(rawData)` block.

### H9. Owners sub-tab on the year-scoped Accounting page shows ALL-TIME owner totals
- **Root cause:** `webapps/landlord/src/pages/[organization]/accounting/[year].js:71-74` — `fetchOwners()` called with no year, queryKey `[QueryKeys.OWNERS]` has no year; `ownermanager.all` (`:512`) + `_aggregateOwners` (`:323`) iterate `ownerMonthlyExpenses` across ALL terms with no year filter. The per-owner statement PDF (`:174-189`) IS year-scoped.
- **Trigger:** Open Accounting 2024 → Incoming/Outgoing/Payments show 2024; Owners tab shows Paid/Outstanding summed over 2024+2025+2026; figures contradict the year-scoped statement PDF beside them.
- **Impact:** Owner Paid/Outstanding under a year heading include other years' charges; can't reconcile with the year's tabs or the downloadable statement.
- **Fix direction:** Pass the page `year`: `fetchOwners(year)` → `GET /owners?year=`, queryKey `[OWNERS, year]`, and filter `Number(row.term)` to that year's term window in `_aggregateOwners`.

### H10. Bill confirm-payment marks bills fully paid with ZERO amount reconciliation; shared-RF match is non-deterministic
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/billmanager.ts:397` (parses only RF, no receipt amount), `:409-413` (`findOne({rfCode,status:'pending'})` no `.sort()`; rfCode non-unique per `bill.ts:37`), `:467-477` (`confirmPayment` `$set status:'paid'`, no `totalAmount` comparison).
- **Trigger:** Upload a €40 partial-payment receipt whose RF matches a €400 pending bill (or, with two months sharing an RF, an arbitrary month) → Confirm → bill flips to fully paid.
- **Impact:** A partially-paid (or wrong-month) bill silently drops from the pending-bills dashboard tile; landlord stops chasing real debt. (Bill collection is decoupled from the rent ledger — severity is medium in practice, not high, but it's a real money-tracking defect.)
- **Fix direction:** Parse and return the receipt's paid amount; reject/flag confirm when it doesn't reconcile against `bill.totalAmount`; add a deterministic `.sort()` + disambiguation when an rfCode matches multiple pending bills.

## MEDIUM — wrong-render / silent under-coverage / locale on money surfaces

### M1. Property expense-sum ignores each expense's begin/end window — one-time/sub-period charges inflate the "recurring" monthly Total
- **Root cause:** `frontdata.ts:495-505` sums ALL `properties[].expenses[].amount` unconditionally (begin/end only string-formatted at `:479-486`); engine windows them (`businesslogic/tasks/1_base.ts:890-911`). `RentOverviewCard.js:22-29` labels it RECURRING monthly.
- **Trigger:** Tenant with a One-time expense (`begin===end`, `LeaseContractForm.js:211-220`) or custom sub-period → overview Additional charges/Total inflated by the full one-time amount every month, plus re-taxed via `vat=preTaxTotal*vatRatio` (`:507`).
- **Impact:** Overview overstates monthly liability vs the ledger; VAT compounds the error.
- **Fix direction:** Skip expenses whose `[beginDate,endDate]` window excludes the summarized period in the `:495` reduce (or relabel the figure as a lifetime total). Engine side is already correct.

### M2. Express drawer only settles the current 21-row pagination page; arrears on pages 2+ silently skipped
- **Root cause:** `ResourceList/List.js:36` (`pageSize=21`), `:112` (`renderList({data: chunks[safePageIndex-1]})`); `RentTable.js:645` passes that slice to `ExpressPaymentDialog rents={rents}`; dialog derives `eligible` solely from the prop (`ExpressPaymentDialog.js:39-76`), no independent fetch.

- **Impact:** Silent under-collection masquerading as full collection.
- **Fix direction:** Feed the dialog the full `filteredData` (or unfiltered month) instead of the single page chunk at `List.js:112`.

### M3. Rent-call email itemized table never reconciles to its printed Total (VAT/discount/debts/balance rows omitted)
- **Root cause:** `services/emailer/src/emailparts/contents/rentcall/body_html.ejs:23-32` lists only preTaxAmounts+charges+buildingCharges then prints Total=`grandTotal`; `grandTotal` (`7_total.ts:64-67`) also includes vat − discount + debts + balance, none rendered. `body_text.ejs:7-15` same. Sibling PDF (`rentcalltotal.ejs:13-21`, `invoicebody.ejs:75-91`) DOES render them.
- **Trigger:** Tenant with the table-gate met (`:21`: ≥1 buildingCharge / >1 preTaxAmount / ≥1 charge) AND nonzero VAT/discount/debt/carried balance → visible rows don't sum to the bold Total.
- **Impact:** Tenant-facing payment demand looks like it mis-adds; disputes; disagrees with the attached PDF.
- **Fix direction:** Add VAT/discount(negative)/debts/Previous-balance rows before the Total (mirror `rentcalltotal.ejs`), or print a subtotal-of-listed-lines label.

### M4. Incoming-tenants tab renders TODAY's date as every tenant's contract end
- **Root cause:** `accountingmanager.ts:199-208` (`_incomingTenants` deliberately dropped `endDate` per Wave-24 B15) vs `webapps/landlord/src/components/accounting/IncomingTenants.js:37-38` which still renders `moment(tenant.endDate).format('L')`; `moment(undefined)` → now (valid).
- **Trigger:** Open Accounting → Incoming tenants → every row reads `<beginDate> - <today>`; the end date advances daily.
- **Impact:** Fabricated, non-deterministic contract-end on every incoming tenant; disagrees with the (correct) CSV which omits the column.
- **Fix direction:** Stop rendering the end-date side at `IncomingTenants.js:38` (match the CSV), or guard on `tenant.endDate` presence.

### M5. Settlements CSV fabricates TODAY's date as begin/end for a tenant missing beginDate/endDate/terminationDate
- **Root cause:** `accountingmanager.ts:294` (begin) and `:297-299` (end) — `moment.utc(undefined)` → today (valid), no falsy guard; embedded in the multiline "tenant" cell at `:388-392`. Siblings `_incomingTenants:193-197` / `_outgoingTenants:236-240` DO guard with `? … : ''`.
- **Trigger:** Tenant with a year-matching rent but no begin/termination/end (legacy/mongo-seed) → download Payments CSV → "tenant" cell shows `<today> - <today>`; drifts daily.
- **Impact:** Fabricated, drifting lease period in an accounting export; corrupts period-keyed reconciliation. (On-screen view fabricates the same value — CSV and UI actually agree on the wrong date.)
- **Fix direction:** Add the sibling guard `value ? moment.utc(value).format('YYYY-MM-DD') : ''` at `:294` and `:297-299`.

### M6. Tenant payment / owner payment success toasts + allocation warnings render dot-decimal + glued/hardcoded € ignoring org locale/currency
- **Root cause (same pattern, 3 surfaces):** `PaymentTabs.js:649-653` (`_sum.toFixed(2)` into key `'Payment of {{amount}}€ recorded'`); `OwnerPaymentDialog.js:138-140/214-217/474-480` (over-allocated / unallocated / success, `.toFixed(2)` into €-baked keys); locale values bake € (`el/common.json:566/618/1122`). These bypass `useFormatNumber`/`NumberFormat` used for every other amount in the same dialogs.

### M7. Surplus-credit badge + RentSelector "Remaining" render dot-decimal/hardcoded € (or no symbol) ignoring locale

Sibling `RentTable.js:511` uses locale-aware `NumberFormat`.
- **Trigger:** el/non-EUR org, overpaid term → badge shows `+12.50€` beside `1.234,56 €`; RentSelector Remaining shows `1234.50` with no currency.
- **Impact:** Wrong-locale money on the rents grid and payment picker; visually inconsistent with same-row formatted amounts.
- **Fix direction:** Route both through `NumberFormat`/`useFormatNumber` and strip the literal € from the surplus key.

## LOW — config-integrity / rendering / rejected-valid-data / latent crash

### L1. `POST /realms` (`add`) never validates currency against the ISO whitelist that `update()` enforces
- **Root cause:** `realmmanager.ts:160-176` validates name+locale but no `validateEnum(currency,CURRENCIES)`; `_hasRequiredFields:51` checks truthiness only; schema `realm.ts:114` has no enum.
- **Trigger:** `POST /realms {currency:'NOTACURRENCY'}` → 200, persisted. Feeds H5 (accounting 500) and H6 (PATCH lockout).
- **Fix direction:** Mirror `update()`'s `validateEnum(req.body.currency, CURRENCIES, 'currency')` into `add()`.

### L2. Zero-decimal currencies (JPY) render with two forced decimals everywhere
- **Root cause:** `minimumFractionDigits:2` hardcoded in `accountingmanager.ts:172/220/284`, `pdfgenerator templatefunctions.ts:24`, `numberformat.js:5`; JPY whitelisted (`validators.ts:60`).
- **Trigger:** Realm with currency JPY → `¥1,234.50` instead of `¥1,235` on every receipt/CSV/screen.
- **Fix direction:** Don't force `minimumFractionDigits` for zero-fraction currencies (let Intl use the ISO-4217 default, or special-case KRW/JPY/etc).

### L3. Multi-property tenant PDF (receipt + rent-call) names only the first property's address while billing all
- **Root cause:** `services/pdfgenerator/data/index.js:146-152` (`propertyAddress` = `dbTenant.properties[0]` only, "First property only" comment); body loops all `preTaxAmounts` (`invoicebody.ejs:47-54`); single-row `customerreference.ejs:11-15`.
- **Trigger:** Tenant with ≥2 active properties (apartment+storage) → body lists both rents, address block names one.
- **Fix direction:** Join the addresses of all term-active properties in the `propertyAddress` builder (or iterate the row), matching the body's active set.

### L4. One-time/custom expense date inputs bound to LEASE range, not property entry/exit → server 422s valid mid-handover entries
- **Root cause:** `LeaseContractForm.js:215-216/281/285/512` bind expense dates + Add-expense seed to lease begin/end; server validates against property entry/exit (`occupantmanager.ts:686-696`).
- **Trigger:** Property with `entryDate` after lease begin → add any expense (defaults to lease begin) → Save → 422 "beginDate cannot be before property entryDate".
- **Fix direction:** Bind expense date min/max + the one-time pin + Add-expense seed to `property.entryDate`/`exitDate` (fallback to lease begin/end).

### L5. `toOccupantData` crashes (500, blank tenant page) on a property with no `expenses` array
- **Root cause:** `frontdata.ts:479` — `item.expenses.forEach(...)` unguarded, while the sum-loop at `:496` IS guarded and the engine guards (`1_base.ts:883`); aggregate/`.lean()` fetch paths skip the Mongoose `[]` default.
- **Trigger:** Tenant with a property entry lacking the `expenses` key (legacy/mongo-seed) → GET `/tenants/:id` or `/rents/tenant/:id` → 500, tenant Rental overview blanks.
- **Fix direction:** `(item.expenses || []).forEach(...)` at `:479`, matching the engine guard.

### L6. Saved IRIS QR is write-only and can never be regenerated
- **Root cause:** `billmanager.ts:296-298/315` persists `irisCodeUrl` but it has zero readers anywhere; `paymentCode` always stored null because `BillImportDialog.handleConfirm:176-190` never forwards it → `generateIrisQr` returns null (`index.ts:67`); `irisCodeBase64` schema field never written.

### L7. Express settle records UTC date while drawer header shows LOCAL date — off-by-one near Athens midnight
- **Root cause:** `ExpressPaymentDialog.js:219` shows `moment().format('DD/MM/YYYY')` (local); `rentmanager.ts:504` stamps `moment.utc().format('DD/MM/YYYY')` (used `:603`); response carries no date back.
- **Trigger:** Record via Express at 01:30 Athens → header "16/06", payment persisted "15/06".

### L8. DEH bill amount parser misreads a bare thousands-dot (no comma) as a decimal point
- **Root cause:** `services/api/src/managers/billparser/deh.ts:5-8` — dot-thousands/comma-decimal normalization runs only `if (cleaned.includes(','))`; `parseFloat('1.234')` → 1.234.
- **Trigger:** DEH total printed as a round-thousands amount without cents, e.g. `1.234 €` → parses €1.23. (Low likelihood: Greek invoices conventionally always print `,NN`.)

### L10. Zero-amount (credit) DEH bill renders an em-dash in the import preview; bill dates use browser OS locale
- **Root cause:** `BillImportDialog.js:64` (`<NumberFormat value={parsed.totalAmount}/>` with no `showZero` → `'—'` for 0 per `NumberFormat.js:50-56`); `:69-70/76` use `toLocaleDateString()` with no locale arg (browser/OS locale, not org locale).
